iebc_gazette_2022.note: Primary legal publication. Domestic ward values in the First Schedule total 22,102,532 registered voters. Sprint 2 publishes ward values as official direct observations and constituency values as official-derived sums of the ward schedule, with reconciliation checks to the county schedule.
